senses.gloss: m. (a sing. of κελεόντες, as if κελέονς) beam of the loom, in gen. beam, pole.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 20:3">Kel. XX, 3</cite> <he>קבעו בכ׳</he> if he inserted the transverse staff of the loom in the beam; <he>כסא שקבעו בכ׳</he> if one fixes a chair on the top of a beam; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 11:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. XI, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 3:3">Zab. III, 3</cite> <he>על הכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>האכ׳</he>) was seated on a beam.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:2">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 2</cite> <he>כליניס</he> ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 7:2">Ib. VII, 2</cite> <cite ref="K00727"><he>כליונים</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (ed. <cite ref="K00740"><he>כלינוס</he></cite>, corr. acc.). [<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 24">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXIV</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00740"><he>כָּלִינוֹס</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>כְּלוֹנְסוֹת</he>, <he>כְּלוֹנְסִיּוֹת</he>, <he>כְּלוֹנְסָאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 67b:3">B. Bath. 67ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>בתולות</he>) <he>כ׳ של ארז וכ׳</he> cedar beams supporting the transverse press beam.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:3">R. Hash. II, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 22b:12">22ᵇ</cite>) <he>כלונסא׳</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>קְלוֹנְסוֹת</he>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:2">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 2</cite>; a. e.
